SELECT d.id AS dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.status, d.create_time , d.update_time , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.dept_id = d.id AND u.deleted = 0 ) AS user_count FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.deleted = 0
AND d.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deptName}, '%')
AND d.status = #{status}
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
